description: Dakota BJ623 (c/n 12928, ex USAAF 42-108908, Bharat Airways/Air-India VT-CGP) presented in the early 1980s by AOC Jorhat to 8 Mountain Division and assembled at Jakhama cantonment (now Assam Rifles IG premises) south of Kohima. Source warbirds.in (2011, photos D M Subaiya, Temjen Jamir), bharat-rakshak.
